title: Robert Half selected by Forbes as one of the World's Best Employers 2026
summary: Global talent solutions and business consulting firm Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) has been named by Forbes as one of the World's Best Employers 2026. This recognition highlights multinational companies...
body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Oct. 6, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global talent solutions and business consulting firm[Robert Half](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790833-1&h=3950247480&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.roberthalf.com%2Fus%2Fen&a=Robert+Half) (NYSE: RHI) has been named by Forbes as one of the[World's Best Employers 2026](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790833-1&h=2613534556&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.forbes.com%2Flists%2Fworlds-best-employers%2F&a=World%27s+Best+Employers+2026) . This recognition highlights multinational companies that demonstrate a strong commitment to employee well-being and an exceptional workplace experience.


Forbes' World's Best Employers list is based on an independent survey of more than 300,000 employees across 50 countries. Respondents rated their employers on employee satisfaction, workplace culture and reputation, with particular attention to well-being, inclusivity, career growth and work-life balance—underscoring what it takes to be a top employer on a global scale.


"Being named one of the World's Best Employers reflects the dedication, talent and collaboration of our employees around the world," said M. Keith Waddell, president and chief executive officer of Robert Half. "We are committed to fostering an environment where people can grow their careers, do meaningful work, and make a positive impact for our clients, colleagues and communities."


Robert Half's[employee commitment](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790833-1&h=2112366005&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.roberthalf.com%2Fglobal%2Fen%2Fworking-at-robert-half&a=employee+commitment) is grounded in its core values of integrity, inclusion, innovation and commitment to success. The company supports employees through opportunities to grow their careers, contribute meaningful work and make an impact in the communities where they live and work.


The company has also been named a World's Most Admired Company by Fortune and one of the Best Employers for Company Culture by Forbes.


**FAQs:**
**How were companies selected for this recognition?**
Forbes' World's Best Employers list is based on an independent survey of more than 300,000 employees across 50 countries. Employees evaluated employers on factors including workplace culture, well-being, inclusivity, career development, work-life balance and whether they would recommend their employer to others.


**Why was Robert Half recognized?**
Robert Half was recognized for its commitment to creating an exceptional workplace experience where employees can grow their careers, do meaningful work and make a positive impact. The company fosters an organizational culture grounded in its core values of integrity, inclusion, innovation and commitment to success.


**What does this recognition mean for Robert Half?**
This recognition reinforces Robert Half's reputation as an employer of choice and reflects the company's ongoing commitment to supporting employee well-being, career growth and a positive workplace culture. It also highlights the strength of the company's people-first approach across its global workforce.


**About Robert Half**
Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) is the world's first and largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm, connecting highly skilled job seekers with rewarding opportunities at great companies. We offer contract talent and full-time solutions in the fields of finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support, and we also provide executive search services.


Robert Half is the parent company of Protiviti®, a global consulting firm that delivers internal audit, risk, business and technology consulting solutions. In the last 12 months, Robert Half has been recognized as one of America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune and, with Protiviti, has been named a Fortune® Most Admired Company™ and one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For. Explore talent solutions, research and insights at[RobertHalf.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790833-1&h=2890760654&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.roberthalf.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3DPress_Release%26utm_medium%3DLink%26utm_source%3DPress_Release&a=RobertHalf.com) .
